name: AUREL
subtitle: Jewelry identity
description: A refined jewelry identity pairing ivory paper, burgundy packaging, and sculptural gold forms. A study in quiet confidence, tactile materials, and editorial restraint.

name: FORMA
subtitle: Brand in space
description: A contemporary identity built around cobalt geometry, architectural imagery, and a clear typographic voice. The system moves from personal stationery to large-scale public applications.

name: CANTO
subtitle: Artisan vermouth
description: Botanical illustration and rich, earthy color bring an artisan drinks concept to life. Bottle, gift box, and table setting explore a warm, considered retail experience.

name: DOLCE
subtitle: A sweeter ritual
description: A premium waffle-cone packaging study with elegant cylindrical tins, illustrated flavor cues, and gold finishes. The range balances shelf presence with the intimacy of a gift.

name: NORI
subtitle: Little people, bright days
description: A playful childrenswear concept built on navy, butter yellow, and soft geometric forms. Packaging, garment details, and campaign styling share an approachable retail language.

name: VECTOR
subtitle: Performance in detail
description: A sportswear design study exploring compression silhouettes, engineered seam lines, and tactile fabric surfaces. Graphite and electric lime establish a precise athletic direction.

name: AFTERHOURS
subtitle: Same sky, different angles
description: An expressive streetwear capsule combining distressed typography, orbital imagery, and washed black textiles. Graphic exploration extends into garment applications and editorial styling.

name: LIMON
subtitle: The lemon grove collection
description: A botanical textile concept inspired by watercolor, summer kitchens, and the natural texture of linen. Lemons, leafy branches, and small flowers form a relaxed homeware language.

name: The Silent Archive
subtitle: A story hidden in the margins
description: A literary thriller cover exploration built from archival fragments, shadowed doorways, and a single red thread. The imagery suggests memory, investigation, and stories waiting to be discovered.

name: Small Hours
subtitle: Room for the story
description: An editorial concept using generous margins, restrained serif typography, and atmospheric imagery. Chapter openers, interior spreads, and a book presentation explore a calm reading experience.

name: Little Strikers
subtitle: An adventure in every match
description: A black-and-white football adventure following a young player from discovery to a decisive match and team celebration. Expressive characters and cinematic compositions carry the story.

name: CASA CALMA
subtitle: Architecture for slower living
description: A contemporary residential concept explored through travertine, walnut, limewash, and warm natural light. Exterior, living, and kitchen studies share a tactile architectural mood.

name: MOSS
subtitle: A small world, richly imagined
description: A stylized wildlife world combining a faceted fox character with atmospheric forest scenes. Angular forms, warm light, and a restrained natural palette create a distinctive visual language.

name: LUMA
subtitle: The daily ritual
description: A sculptural beauty campaign concept exploring pearl surfaces, translucent water, and apricot light. Product and material studies build a soft, luminous visual identity.

name: PULSE
subtitle: Play next
description: Three keyframes for a gaming-store promotion, moving from a dramatic controller reveal to a game showcase and closing brand frame. Chrome, violet, and cyan give the sequence its energy.

name: ATELIER 08
subtitle: A study in silhouette
description: A fashion-film treatment bringing cream tailoring into dramatic architectural settings. A hero composition, tactile close-up, and closing brand frame establish the proposed visual rhythm.
stack: Premiere Pro · DaVinci Resolve · After Effects

name: ORBIT
subtitle: Make room for focus
description: An explainer treatment for a productivity concept. The three visual beats move from everyday overload to organization and a calm closing invitation.
stack: Premiere Pro · After Effects · Illustrator · Audition

name: BRASA
subtitle: Gather around the fire
description: A restaurant campaign built around fire-grilled food, warm light, and refined typography. Food imagery, a menu study, and an advertisement express a generous, sensory dining experience.

name: VELA
subtitle: Simple by nature
description: A skincare commerce concept pairing spacious layouts and clear hierarchy with botanical product imagery. Desktop, mobile, and advertising studies explore a consistent customer experience.

name: SONORA
subtitle: Night. Sound. City.
description: An expressive music-event identity exploring experimental typography, sound-wave forms, and a vivid blue-and-coral palette. Poster, outdoor, and social studies carry the energy across formats.
